senses.gloss: מַלֵּיל, מַלֵּל ch. same, in gen. to speak (corresp. to b. h. דִּבֵּר, שִׂיחַ).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 34:3">Targ. Gen. XXXIV, 3</cite> (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="M01542"><he>מַלֵּי</he></cite>). Ib. XVII, 22, sq.; a. v. fr.—Part. <cite ref="M01673"><he>מְמַלֵּל</he></cite>, <he>מְמַלְּלָא</he> &c. (in ed. frequ. with one <cite ref="M00000"><he>מ</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 2:10">Targ. Job II, 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 50a:14">Kidd. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>מְמַלֵּי מילי עלוי</he> (= <he>מְמלְּלֵי</he>) they speak against me.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 87:3">Targ. Ps. LXXXVII, 3</cite>.
Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 16; a. e.—Y. Shek. VI, 50, top (play on שחו, Ez. XLVII, 5) [read:] מאי מי שחו מיין דמִתְמַלְּלִין וכ׳ what is me saḥu? Waters which are spoken of in the world (v. שִׂיחַ).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 33:9">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXIII, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 2:2">Targ. Ez. II, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 1:28">I, 28</cite>; a. e.
